verdict.rationale: Gemini CLI documents its own ability to edit large codebases and to automate tasks like handling complex rebases, which partly covers resolving merge conflicts. It does not specifically document writing tests, fixing lint errors, or updating dependencies. Community reports of agentic edit failures and loops lower confidence but do not concretely contradict these specific tasks. Missing for 10: documented test generation, lint-fix workflows, dependency update support, explicit merge-conflict resolution, and independent hands-on corroboration of these tasks.

support.subject: As a developer, I can have the agent write tests, fix lint errors, resolve merge conflicts, and update dependencies for me

citations.quote: Automate operational tasks like querying pull requests or handling complex rebases
Debug issues and troubleshoot with natural language
